scope: N=3 Q=2 v0.3 digital research profile; evidence is not physical qualification

Fixed issue, expiry, clock and stop bounds
Fixed N=3 Q=2 and public OTP checks
Commissioning interlocks and permanent closure
Selected official cases and real complete signatures
No pre-issue samples or future nonce pool
Repeat history and reset freshness
requirements.required_test: *warm and recognized cold retain repeat history*

Distinct authorities and fixed 2-of-3 quorum
Local expected grant and canonical Merkle paths
Independent two-pass acceptance and final join

requirements.goal: Independent trusted progress and overflow rejection
Single sealed receive SRAM and exact SPI envelopes
Declared SRAM and common read/capture fault domains
Repeated/persistent acceptance-path campaigns
Two independently enforcing local guard paths
Static rails, frozen source and permissive local guard faults

Independent protected state/capture updates and confirmed general fault applications
requirements.required_test: *independent controller capture and sequencer update faults*

known_gaps.detail: No assessed entropy, absolute clock floor, analog sensors, metastability, placement/isolation or physical stop qualification.

R03 digital protections, catalog and confirmed applications are implemented. Sites/values/durations outside the declared campaigns, shared upstream/common physical faults and post-layout preservation remain unqualified. Public fault manifests replay initial ARM jobs only; masked persistent faults hold the whole selected site rather than leaving unmasked bits live.
Generic component synthesis and structural CDC inventory are separate from full-device mapping/STA/CDC/RDC, four-state power sequencing, macro substitution and redundant-path preservation.

Test keys/policies are not durable admission, replicated operator holds, production custody or authority capacity. Profile assumes 80 ms signing plus 20 ms batch/relay; measured serial host signing can exceed W.
Small actual-RTL bounded properties only, with explicit environment/scope. No whole-device inductive, crypto, asynchronous analog or comprehensive X proof.
The reference Authority has policy, registration, delay and batch checks but no aggregate four-candidate rolling admission ledger. No model or production admission-cap claim is made.

Digital interlocks and a behavioral OTP model exist; the trusted physical appliance, genuine identity/key validation, fresh off-device signed registration records and production custody/closure workflow are not implemented.
Cycle, wall-time and throughput reports exist; the plan also requests peak host-memory measurements for a single pass, two-pass vote and SPI ARM, which are not collected.
